name: One Euro For Skier
teaser: Skier trades with Euros because he wants to travel to Europe. Help him.
description_html:
**Tired of rubles and dollars? Why does Peacekeeper trade in Dollars but we don’t have anyone trading in Euros? Skier is the solution.

Features:**

  • Skier now sells all its products using Euros.
  • Skier buys your products using Euros.
  • Mission rewards changed from Rubles to Euros (Dollar rewards are still in dollars)
  • For the inconvenience generated, Skier rewards you with 25% more Euros.
  • Now Skier levels up by trading with Euros.
  • Prices of items are balanced using current RUB=EUR ratio. (Exactly 168:1 at this point).
  • Easy installation, just Drag&Drop without configuration.
  • Fully compatible with my other mod, Ammo Pack Discount.
  • Euro item from Skier, is obviously blacklisted.

Euro blacklist demostration:

Please note:

  1. If you have already started a mission, it may not reward you with Euros.
  2. You may have to start spending Euros again to level up Skier, or you may have already exceeded the limit.
  3. If an item has a weird price, maybe another mod is editing the prices or multiplying them after my mod set it to euros. Check it out by putting this mod at the bottom of the loading list.

Known bugs:

  • Daily missions continue to provide the reward in rubles. (Thanks to Apyeks)
  • Weapon repair using Skier is still purchased using Rubles.

Thats All.

If you have any suggestions or problems, please do not hesitate to contact me. Enjoy!

If you want to contribute your grain of sand to my work and actively support it, you can help me here!
